artifact_observations.location: Yellow plush toy on the right wall
artifact_observations.reasoning: The plush toy has a slightly 'smudged' or overly smooth texture lacking distinct fabric fibers, and its attachment point to the wall is ambiguous/soft.

artifact_observations.location: Vertical lines of the bookcase and curtain
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight warping in the vertical lines of the curtain and bookcase edge, suggesting minor geometric instability typical of generative models, though not catastrophic.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar shelving unit or cabinet.
To verify the physical depth of the shelves and ensure the books are properly contained within the 3D space rather than floating or merging with the back panel.
To check for boundary bleeding between individual books and the shelf edges, ensuring distinct object separation.
To rigorously analyze the legibility and structural integrity of the text on the book spines, a common failure point in AI images.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric consistency of shelf depth and book placement
Boundary sharpness between books and shelf surfaces
Structural integrity of the bookcase frame (vertical/horizontal alignment)
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text auditor's findings on the book spines. If the text is completely nonsensical or melted, this is a significant artifact despite the overall structural correctness of the bookcase. Also, verify if the geometric depth auditor detects any 'floating' books that do not properly rest on the shelf surfaces.
